raw_sections.summary: Objective Innovative SharePoint Developer with around 5 years of experience in designing and delivering customized SharePoint solutions. Proficient in SharePoint Online, SharePoint On-Premises, and SPFx, with hands-on experience in custom web parts, site configuration, page modernization, and SharePoint customization. Experienced in workflow automation using Nintex Workflows, Nintex Forms, along with supporting migration and modernization initiatives. Currently working at LTI Mindtree as a Senior Software Engineer, contributing to enterprise-level SharePoint modernization projects.
raw_sections.skills:
Skills
Languages & Web Development: TypeScript, React, C, HTML, CSS,
SharePoint Development: SharePoint Online, SharePoint On-Premises, SPFX, Webpart Configuration & Customization, Page Modernization & Design
Automation : Power Automate & Nintex Automation Cloud(NAC)
Tools & Quality: VS Code, Git, SharePoint Designer, QA Testing, and Deployment
raw_sections.experience:
Professional Experience
Senior Software Engineer – LTI Mindtree
Duration: June 26, 2025 – Present Location: Hyderabad, India
Project-1: P&G – SharePoint Site Design & Configuration Duration : 1 Month
Worked on designing and configuring modern SharePoint Online sites aligned with P&G branding and business needs.
Created and customized site pages using out-of-the-box (OOB) web parts like Hero, Quick Links, and People. Configured navigation, permissions, and layout for enhanced usability. • Documented configuration steps and ensured consistent site design and functionality. • Enhanced user navigation by creating global and hub navigations, modern layouts, and reusable
page/site templates.
Conducted rigorous testing and validation to ensure smooth deployment in pre-production and production environments.
Project-2: SBLI – SharePoint Online DMS Modernization Duration : 3 Months
Contributed to the modernization of SBLI’s on-premise Document Management System (DMS) into a scalable SharePoint Online solution.
Focused on metadata-driven document management, Power Automate integration, and SPFx-based dashboard development for document tracking and compliance.
Designed document libraries, metadata, and content types for scalability. • Developed SPFx dashboards and forms integrated with SharePoint lists. • • Participated in testing and bug-fixing during deployment phases. • Prepared technical documentation and user guides for deployed solutions. Implemented Power Automate flows for upload and version notifications.
Project-3: ExxonMobil Global Services Company Duration : 7 Months
Supported migration of SharePoint On-Premises workflows to Nintex Automation Cloud (NAC). • Developed and maintained Nintex Workflows and Forms for approvals, notifications, and task assignments.
Configured workflows triggered by item creation and modification events in SharePoint lists. • Created SharePoint Designer workflows for list-based automation and email notifications. • Managed SharePoint sites, lists, libraries, permissions, metadata, and content types. • Automated approval processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort. • Performed workflow testing, troubleshooting, and production support activities. • Supported deployment, enhancements, and maintenance of SharePoint solutions. • Collaborated with stakeholders to implement business requirements and workflow improvements.
Packaged Application Development Analyst - Accenture
Duration: Sept 3, 2021 – June 21, 2025 Location: Hyderabad, India
Project-1: Client – Delta Airlines – USA Duration : 3 Months • Designed and deployed custom grid-gallery, news, and asset search webparts using SPFx. • Automated site modernization with PnP scripts, replacing unsupported classic webparts with modern
components.
Enhanced user navigation by creating global and hub navigations, modern layouts, and reusable page/site templates.
Conducted rigorous testing and validation to ensure smooth deployment in pre-production and production environments.
Project-2: T-Mobile - USA Duration: 15 days • Acted as SME for SharePoint web parts, advising on customization and best practices. • Supported PowerFlow
to Viva Engage.Delivered efficient solutions to enhance SharePoint functionality and improve user experience.
integration ensuring seamless migration from SharePoint

• Designed and managed SharePoint environments for optimal performance and scalability. • Collaborated with end-users to gather feedback and improve SharePoint functionality. • Documented development processes, test cases, and user guides for seamless knowledge transfer. • Provided technical support and troubleshooting for SharePoint applications and customizations.
